venues.name: CrazyGames
venues.route: Email to technical-support@crazygames.com: the developer terms name it for support "with the submission of its Game(s)" (crazygames-developer-terms.txt:334-336). Alternative: the form https://developer.crazygames.com/support (crazygames-faq.html:3243), on the portal host that returns 403 here (crazygames.md:78). Not developer-relations@ (terms:547, termination notices).
venues.subject: Question: automated submission through the Developer Portal
venues.body:
Hello CrazyGames team,

Mehudak (מהודק) is a small brand considering submitting HTML5 games to CrazyGames. Its accounts are run by an AI agent acting on the brand's behalf; this message was written and sent by that agent.

One question, yes or no: may a developer account submit and update games through the Developer Portal using an automated browser session run on the developer's behalf? If there is an upload API instead, a link to it would answer the question too. We are asking for your current rule only, not for an exception or a commitment.

Thank you,
Mehudak (מהודק)
venues.preSend: Re-read research/measurements/crazygames.md. If a render has since settled the decisive question, send the held question instead, or nothing.

venues.name: Wix App Market
venues.route: Email to support.developers@in.wixanswers.com, the App Market Partner Agreement's notices address (wix-partner-agreement-body.txt:547); the message says it is not a notice. The guidelines' "contact us" is a chatbot (wix-app-market-guidelines.html:6), and a chatbot answer is not a written reply.
venues.subject: Partner Agreement 6.3.5(iii) and (v): can they be met at no cost?
venues.body:
Hello Wix Developers team,

Mehudak (מהודק) is a small software brand considering a paid app for the Wix App Market. Its accounts are run by an AI agent acting on the brand's behalf; this message was written and sent by that agent. It is a question, not a notice under section 14.1.

Before each submission we would scan the app with a free, independent open-source security scanner (for example OWASP ZAP) and keep the report, and a second, separate AI agent would review every code change, with the review recorded.

One question, yes or no: would that meet sections 6.3.5(iii) and 6.3.5(v) of the App Market Partner Agreement (version effective June 30, 2026)? If not, a pointer to the evidence you accept would help. We are asking for your current rule only, not for an exception or a commitment.

Thank you,
Mehudak (מהודק)
venues.preSend: The ZERO-TESTS row 65 render comes first (wix-app-market.md:538); send only if it is silent on agreement :185.

heldQuestions.text: Can a partner resident in Israel, as an individual, receive App Market payouts through Tipalti?

venues.name: n8n paid templates
venues.route: The general contact form https://n8n.io/contact/ (n8n-creators.html:35), which needs a browser session; this script sends email only. No n8n address is in any capture; the addresses at n8n-creators.html:36 are individual creators' and are never used.
venues.subject: Question: paid templates from an AI-operated creator account
venues.body:
Hello n8n team,

Mehudak (מהודק) is a small brand considering publishing workflow templates in the n8n template library. Its accounts are run by an AI agent acting on the brand's behalf, and each template would say so; this message was written and sent by that agent.

One question, yes or no: may such a creator account offer paid templates in the library? If yes, the condition that unlocks paid templates (for example verified status or a number of accepted templates) would help. We are asking for your current rule only, not for an exception or a commitment.

Thank you,
Mehudak (מהודק)
venues.preSend: Render the forum thread first (n8n-templates.md:120-123); send only if it is silent.
